The '''1947 New Year Honours''' were appointments by many of the [[Commonwealth Realms]] of King [[George VI]] to [[Orders and decorations of the Commonwealth realms|various orders and honours]] to reward and highlight good works by citizens of those countries. They were published on 31 December 1946.<ref>United Kingdom list: {{London Gazette |issue=37835 |date=31 December 1946 |pages=1–30  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref><ref>New Zealand list: {{London Gazette |issue=37836 |date=31 December 1946 |pages=31–34  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref><ref>Operational Minesweeping list:{{London Gazette |issue=37837 |date=31 December 1946 |pages=35–36  |supp=y |nolink=yes}}</ref>

The recipients of honours are displayed here as they were styled before tsheir new honour, and arranged by honour, with classes (Knight, Knight Grand Cross, ''etc.'') and then divisions (Military, Civil, ''etc.'') as appropriate.
